resources.string: Show the GameNative Duo panel on the second screen while the game runs. Hidden anyway when External display mode or swap is on.

Notes, checklists, a map picture, a timer and the game\'s own companion cards on the bottom screen. Automatic picks the game\'s companion, else the general one. With screen split on, open it with a two-finger hold on the bottom screen. Tap to change.

Show one tall game screen across both screens: the upper part on top, the lower part below (tap it to click). Set the screen size to %1$d×%2$d and use a game or mod that puts its UI in the lower part. Replaces the bottom-screen panel.

For people making dual-screen mods: the PC editor gets developer tools (inspector, bridge, logs, console, check) usable from duo and duo mcp, the bottom screen menu offers a developer overlay, and mods pushed with duo dev load instead of the installed ones.
Native touch on the bottom screen

Taps and drags go straight to the game\'s menus and HUD, like a touchscreen: no cursor, and the game never switches to mouse controls. Needs the game\'s GameNative Duo mod; otherwise taps act as mouse clicks. Hold two fingers on the bottom screen in game for the layout editor.
Split mode: zoomed part of the game

Tap to change. Tall window: for games with a dual-screen mod (set by the Dual screen switch). Zoomed part: any game, unchanged on top, with a magnified part of it (a minimap…) on the bottom screen; hold two fingers on the bottom screen in game to choose which part.

Tap to change. Lower is much faster (the split window is twice a 1080p frame at 100%%) and the picture is scaled up on both screens. Unity games: set the in-game resolution to the new window size once.
